record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: Chingling (2 stars, passive CHINGLING) and Chimecho (3 stars, passive CHIMECHO) declare ECHO; both range 2, maxPP 75. The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star index and passive. The passives are not covered here.
record.summary: Target-free. The base process increments count.ult BEFORE the strategy reads it: radius 2 + count.ult and damage count.ult x [3, 6, 9, 12] (fallback 12). A 2-star caster's first cast has range 3 and raw 6, the second range 4 and raw 12 (3 stars: 9 / 18). count.ult is generic cast history (any earlier cast raises it). Hits every opposing occupant of the clipped radius disc dx^2 + dy^2 < (floor(range) + 0.5)^2, the centre excluded; team inequality is the only filter.

targeting.who: every occupant of cells in the radius whose team differs from the caster's
targeting.note: Team inequality is the only filter: no isTargettableBy check is made, so any occupant of another team in the area is hit (including untargettable or non-attackable ones if such states exist; not traced). Every hit uses the same amount. The caster's own cell is excluded.

geometry.shape: clipped disc: cells with dx^2 + dy^2 < (floor(radius) + 0.5)^2 on the board (Board.getCellsInRadius), centre excluded; radius = 2 + count.ult (executed on the real Board: range 3 reaches distance^2 9 and 10 but not 13 or 18; range 4 reaches 16 and 18, the bound being 20.25)

effects.target: each enemy in the disc, once
effects.scaling: requested amount = count.ult x table value (table is per cast; count.ult is read after this cast incremented it). Then AP: x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost default true); the cast's crit flag multiplies by critPower only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault false, so needs ABILITY_CRIT); the crit flag is shared by all targets of the cast.
effects.resolution: applied: per target division by (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x SPE_DEF), shields and other untraced modifiers; minimum 1 after ceil. Blocked per target by protect / skydiving / magicBounce (magicBounce reflects SPECIAL damage to the caster unless Protective Pads). No falloff with distance. The returned takenDamage is not read by this ability.

starBehavior.note: table value per unit at its factory stars, multiplied by count.ult at cast time. The 1-star and 4-star columns are declared in the tables but unused by the bound baseline classes (Chingling 2, Chimecho 3). Whether other mechanics raise star counts was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: The radius is centred on the caster's cell at the moment of the cast; only the caster's position and the board occupants matter. Cells off the board are skipped.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: State kept: count.ult, a uint8 counter on the entity, incremented by every cast (any ability, since the increment is in the base process; executed: one earlier base cast makes the first Echo already range 4) and reset to 0 only in the VOLT_SURGE revive path found; it is not reset for ECHO. Its starting value for a fight-created entity is the Count default 0 (entity construction not traced). The uint8 type would wrap after 255 casts (a practical limit not verified).
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: count.ult x 6 (Chingling) or x 9 (Chimecho) per opposing occupant, e.g. 6 / 9 on the first cast and 12 / 18 on the second (executed). Applied per target: x (1 + AP/100), crit factor if the cast crit, SPE_DEF division, minimum 1. The returned values are not read.
